description: You can see how they're put together. Not bones. The decisions: where they chose to stand, which expression they went with, how much of this they're finding difficult.
emotes: {it} picks an expression, tries it, and keeps it.
Something in the way {it} is standing is rebuilt, quietly, and {it} carries on.
{it} does nothing at all, visibly, and it costs {it} something.
looks: The effort of being a person is visible on them, and it's more than you'd assumed.
Several small choices are still being made, live, and you can watch each one land.
Underneath the choosing they're doing fine, which is the reassuring part.
name: somebody with the working shown
says: Everyone's doing this. You are as well.
I'd rather you didn't mention it.
